# Campaign seed (the driver's words, verbatim, 2026-10-04)

I want to build a campaign that will be 3 to 5 sessions. Characters should start at
level 3. I'm wanting to build a campaign around a Time Loop concept where the characters
are stuck on the same day that they keep repeating and have to find a way out of the
loop. I want the setting to be a mountain Kingdom with the passes snowed in such that
the characters would not be able to leave the kingdom in time before the loop resets. I
have a general idea of there being a Bill Murray character who has been looping for a
long time who is crazy but gives hints and gives the character their mission and a
possible way to stop the loop by stopping a ceremony. The ceremony should be a level 5
encounter that will TPK them if they encounter it early and the characters should need
to gather various macguffins to stop the ceremony in various locations and a dungeon
crawl or two in both underground and flying Castle dungeons. I want there to be a large
amount of comedic elements in this, with some random pop culture references and
characters named after various actors or people from history, but just here and there
so not everyone has this setup.

I also want to make sure that for our gameplay using the settings that we build that the
campaign is adjusting the difficulty levels based on some common sense metrics with the
number of player characters available at the time and their relative strengths rather
than a set number of enemies or set difficulty level, so we might need to adjust our
plan for the play loop as well.

To facilitate the time Loop element and manage the difficulty I want the characters to
be given some type of danger stone or something that gives standard MMORPG green,
yellow, and red signals when pointed towards Adventure areas to Signal whether the
difficulty is low or manageable, difficult but doable, or almost certain death, so we
can give an open world feel to the sandbox but also guide the players a bit on things
that they should be doing first. Players should be gaining strength and items and
keeping them through the loops but otherwise waking up in the same bed every morning
after they sleep or after they die. The first encounter for the crew should be one where
they are supposed to die and they wake up for their first Loop.

## Answers to the fill-in questions (2026-10-04)
1. Reset triggers: death, sleep, and the loop's end time. Loop day dawn → midnight.
2. Carried pieces persist; the world's copy regenerates but is inert/hollow; comedy allowed.
3. Kingdom and town names: generate (the driver may have ideas later).
4. Party: up to 4 players.
5. Reveal policy: **paired**. Version A (`campaigns/loop-open/`) fully revealed for critique; version
   B (`campaigns/loop-play/`) secret and played. Criticisms of A become rules applied to B.
6. The looper's secret: revealed in A, secret in B.
